Class SerialGamePersistenceManager

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.persistence.SerialGamePersistenceManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObserver, GamePersistenceManager
public class SerialGamePersistenceManager extends Object implements GamePersistenceManager
GamePersistenceManager that serialises Game objects to .ser files in a configurable directory.

Each call to updateGame(Game) overwrites the file for that game ID (game_<id>.ser). recoverGames() reads all .ser files in the directory on startup. removeGame(int) deletes the file when the game ends.

  • Method Details

    • updateGame

      public void updateGame(Game game)
      Serialises the entire Game object to game_<id>.ser, overwriting any previous snapshot for that game. Called as a GameObserver callback every time the game model changes (i.e. on each move), so the on-disk state always reflects the latest game state and can be used to recover after a crash.
      Specified by:
      updateGame in interface GameObserver
      Parameters:
      game - the updated game model to persist

    • recoverGames

      public List<Game> recoverGames() throws Exception
      Reads every .ser file in saveDirectory and deserialises it back into a Game. Files that fail to deserialise (e.g. corrupted) are skipped and logged, not thrown.
      Specified by:
      recoverGames in interface GamePersistenceManager
      Returns:
      list of recovered games (empty if the directory has no .ser files)
      Throws:
      Exception - if reading the directory itself fails

    • removeGame

      public void removeGame(int gameId) throws Exception
      Deletes the game_<id>.ser snapshot file, if it exists. Called once the game ends or is cancelled, since it no longer needs to be recoverable.
      Specified by:
      removeGame in interface GamePersistenceManager
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game whose snapshot should be removed
      Throws:
      Exception - never thrown directly; I/O errors are caught and logged
